description: Queries a ModMed FHIR server using password/refresh-token authentication with an API key and pushes each returned resource downstream as JSON.

config.label: Interval
config.description: How often, in milliseconds, the runtime invokes the polling script.

config.label: Base URL
config.description: Root URL of the ModMed FHIR endpoint. The token path (ws/oauth2/grant) and FHIR path (fhir/v2/) are appended to it, so a trailing slash is expected (one is added if omitted).

config.label: Username
config.description: ModMed account username used for the initial password grant.

config.label: Password
config.description: ModMed account password used for the initial password grant.

config.label: API Key
config.description: The x-api-key value sent on every request, including the token exchange.

config.label: Resource Type
config.description: FHIR resource type to search on each poll, for example Patient, Encounter or Observation.

config.label: Search Query
config.description: Search parameters as a URL query string, for example _count=20&family=Smith. Leave empty to search without filters.

config.label: Live Mode
config.description: When off, FHIR requests are simulated and no data leaves the runtime. Authentication is always performed live so credential problems surface immediately.

config.label: Verify TLS
config.description: Whether to verify the ModMed server's TLS certificate. Leave on outside of local testing against a proxy.
